name: dsh-fabric
description: Fabric — the everything-is-a-plugin primitive for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Unifies every DSH extensibility seam (tool / skill / command / prompt section / context / variable / event listener / llm adapter / subagent provider / web route / settings namespace / projection / service) behind one declarative DSL, published as a runtime Service plus model-facing tools, so extending the runtime becomes a runtime primitive.
